notes.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden's Patch 1.4 is now live!
notes.content:
Hey Banishers 🕯️

Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden's patch is live! It brings updates, bug fixes and optimizations, make sure to read the list of changes below.

Combat and Enemies 

 Adjusted the behavior of certain enemies and bosses that could make combat much easier in rare configurations. 
 Fixed cases where enemies could not reach the player or remained invisible. 
 Addressed a bug where the "Unable to change equipment" warning was displayed incorrectly, and adjustments to ensure that UI indications accurately reflect the current state of potions and skills. 

Progression et Quests  

 Solved issues blocking progression in certain missions, corrected missing quest markers, and adjustments to ensure the correct triggering of story events. 

Environment and Navigation 

 Fixed issues where the main character could fall through the ground or get stuck in the environment, notably at the entrance to Fort Jericho's barracks and on certain isolated rocks.  
 Corrected certain navigation interactions that were difficult to access or could block the player if interacted with from a specific angle (rope, jump, narrow path). 
 Removed several invisible collisions that could block player movement. 
 Adjusted navigation zones to prevent movement anomalies like falling animations of the hero. 
 Resolved issues with invisible collision preventing the destruction of a soul grabber or a creeping ivy node. 

Cinematics and Dialogues 

 Fixed issues affecting the playback of cinematics and the consistency of dialogues: facial animation problems, overlapping voice-overs, adjustment of the audio volume of certain dialogues or music, camera adjustments hidden by a decor element. 

Visuals 

 Fixed issues related to the display of certain textures, missing or persisting visual effects, and improved the visual integration of environmental settings (rocks, vegetation, snow, etc.). 
 Addressed an animation issue where NPCs like Danniel Keayne and Antea would become invisible under certain conditions. 

Photomode 

 Fixed various bugs related to photo mode (display of interaction input, HUD elements remaining visible, etc.). 
 Addressed issues with camera control in photo mode between AZERTY and QWERTY setups. 
 Fixed a white filter appearing on screenshots in photo mode on Steam. 

Interfaces and Menus 

 Corrected button overlays and visual adjustments to improve readability and interaction. 
 Fixed interface issues, such as skill texts not updating correctly. 

Audio 

 Adjusted the frequency of dynamic dialogues to reduce the excessive repetition of certain lines (e.g: Antea calling for a switch) 
 Resolved issues where music would abruptly cut off in various situations, such as approaching the graveyard at the start of the game, in combat, during certain cinematics, and when using the PS5's share feature. 

Stability and Performance 

 Fixed various crashes and freezes on PC and consoles. 
 Improved overall stability across different platforms, especially concerning framerate drops in dense areas, when moving from one region to another, or during certain player actions. 
 Addressed issues causing delays in opening the in-game menu after long sessions, particularly on PS5. 

Achievements 

 Fixed an issue that could prevent the completion of the "Full Potency" achievement. 

AI 

 Fixed an issue where certain NPC routines did not occur as expected, leading to incorrect visual interactions. 

Localization and Translations 

 Corrected various subtitle and voice-over problems, including gender errors, typos, and narrative inconsistencies in several languages. 

Control Options 

 Fixed an issue affecting key reconfiguration.

notes.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Aye, Banishers! ✨

The wait is finally over! 

We’re very excited to announce that Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden is out now!

Embark on a journey to New Eden, in 1695, where communities of settlers are plagued by a dreadful curse. Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith are two trained spirit-hunters who swore to protect the living from the threat of lingering ghosts and specters. Yet, when tragedy strikes and Antea herself becomes a ghost, you must face a dreadful choice: will you honor your Banisher’s oath to the living or save your departed partner?
As Banishers, step into New Eden’s inhabitants' lives, investigate the source of evil, unravel chilling mysteries, explore diverse landscapes, and interact with unforgettable characters whose fate lies in your hands.

Dive into a powerful and intimate journey in this narrative Action-RPG where your choices wield dramatic consequences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315294/967b22e2c032c16b15ac58fbcd592dfdf48217fc.jpg
A little word from the Dev team!

Hello!

Stéphane and Philippe here. We’re the Narrative Director and Creative Director 
on Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden. We, the whole development team at DON’T 
NOD, and Focus Entertainment are very happy that the game is finally out and in
your hands. We can’t wait to hear what you think about this project that we’ve 
worked so hard on over the past few years. 

We're excited to see you face the challenges and choices you’ll have to make. 
Will you sacrifice the living to bring Antea back, or will you keep your Banisher’s 
oath? After the many decisions you’ll make throughout the game, there are five 
endings for you to reveal and we hope you find them entertaining and satisfying.

Life to the living, Death to the dead.

notes.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden unveils a new poignant story trailer
notes.content:
Aye Banisher! ✨

We're excited to unveil this new emotionally charged story trailer for Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden. This narrative-driven action RPG immerses you in a world teeming with supernatural threats, challenging them to grapple with love, life, death, and sacrifice. 

This new trailer will bring the deeply enthralling and poignant story to life, providing a glimpse into the intricate lore of Banishers and the key relationship between Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith.

[previewyoutube=vJNLXU31VEA;full][/previewyoutube]
In Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, you step into the shoes of Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith, experienced spirit hunters sent to New Eden on a harrowing mission to aid the settlers. 

The stakes escalate dramatically when Antea is tragically killed during an ill-advised attack, becoming one of the very ghosts she once despised and trained her husband to destroy. This catastrophic turn of events leaves Red torn between upholding their oath to protect the living from malevolent spirits and the devastating reality of Antea's condition.

The emotionally charged journey through Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden explores the complex interplay between love, sacrifice, and the struggle to reconcile one's own desires with a sense of duty. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315294/8fd941f60f1ad158eade24acc6bcc5777e21c27f.png
You must navigate this treacherous path, making choices between the living and their beloved.


Delve into the lives of New Eden's communities, a world plagued with supernatural creatures and age-old secrets. Utilize Antea's spiritual abilities and Red's formidable arsenal to banish the tormented souls that haunt the living. 
As you uncover hidden truths, traverse mysterious landscapes, and meet unforgettable characters, their futures - and lives - rest in your hands.

[previewyoutube=sNohIUSnOOE;full][/previewyoutube]

You play a couple of Banishers, Antea Duarte and Red Mac Raith. They are experienced spirit hunters, but after an ill-advised attack, Antea is killed, leaving her lover in solitude and profound despair. Torn between their vows to protect the living from malicious spirits and the nightmare of Antea’s condition, they wander the eerie wilderness of North America to liberate her from her new plight… Whatever the price.

Enter the lives of New Eden’s communities in a world plagued with supernatural creatures and ancient secrets. Combine Antea’s spiritual powers and Red’s powerful arsenal to defeat and banish the souls that torment the living. Uncover secrets, navigate mysterious landscapes, upgrade your gear to unleash another measure of power, and meet memorable but tormented characters whose fate rests in your hands.

Heavy decisions will lie on your path as you decide the fate of New Eden’s inhabitants—be they living people or wandering souls—dramatically impacting your story and the challenges you’ll face. A brand-new extended gameplay trailer of Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden has just been released, showcasing more of the poignant adventure that awaits you in the haunted wilds of 17th Century North America where you will hunt and battle supernatural horrors to alter a very tragic fate.

[previewyoutube=mH2aDGahZ1U;full][/previewyoutube]

Life to the living, Death to the dead
In a world where the souls of the departed roam, you play a couple of Banishers. Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith are experienced spirit hunters, entrusted with the daunting task of lifting a malevolent and ominous curse. After an ill-advised attack, Antea is killed, leaving her lover in solitude and profound despair. Torn between their vows to protect the living from malicious spirits and the nightmare of Antea’s condition, wander the eerie wilderness of North America, to liberate her from her new plight… Whatever the price. 

Enter the lives of New Eden’s communities in a world plagued with supernatural creatures and ancient secrets. Combine Antea’s spiritual powers and Red’s powerful arsenal to defeat and banish the souls that torment the living. Uncover secrets, navigate mysterious landscapes, and meet memorable but tormented characters whose fate rests in your hands.

Heavy decisions will lie on your path as you decide the fate of New Eden’s inhabitants—be they living people or wandering souls—dramatically impacting your story and the challenges you’ll face. Will you honor your Banisher oath or sacrifice the living in a desperate bid to bring your beloved back?

Exclusive editions to embellish your Banisher’s collection ✨
Discover the new Red Echoes Edition, which includes:
 An ancient, leather-effect notebook illustrated with Red's memories

notes.title: Focus Entertainment and DON’T NOD unveil Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
notes.content:
Following the success of Vampyr, Focus Entertainment and DON’T NOD had announced a new collaboration to bring one of the most ambitious projects in the history of both the publisher and the studio. Focus Entertainment’s participation in The Game Awards 2022 is the occasion to unveil this brand new project, set to release in late 2023: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden. 

Experience a powerful and intimate narrative in this Action-RPG, playing as two proficient ghost hunters and lovers, faced with impossible choices and their dramatic consequences for the living… and the dead. The World Premiere Reveal Trailer showcases the hallmarks of DON’T NOD: a striking art direction, strong characters and plot, as well as a unique fantasy world.

[previewyoutube=y4nHiS9O5PM;full]https://youtu.be/y4nHiS9O5PM

[/previewyoutube]“We’re so excited to finally lift the veil on Banishers, a project born from our long-standing partnership with DON’T NOD” says John Bert, Managing Director at Focus Entertainment, “The studio has an unmatched talent for creating worlds that are as unique as they are immersive. They are amazing storytellers who know how to truly enhance an efficient, innovative gameplay with narrative and emotions. That’s exactly what they are doing with Banishers. It’s a very ambitious project, which is sure to receive a very warm welcome from players all around the world”.

"I am very proud of the talented team hard at work developing this exciting new action-RPG and delighted to once again have the privileged support of our accomplished partner Focus Entertainment.” shares Oskar Guilbert, CEO of DON'T NOD, “We are very excited to be at The Game Awards for this announcement and hope that this first teaser gives players a glimpse of the deep and intense experience that Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden will offer. We look forward to revealing more in the coming months!"

About Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
New Eden, 1695. Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith are lovers and Banishers, ghost-hunters who vowed to protect the living from the threat of lingering ghosts and specters. Following a disastrous last mission, Antea is fatally wounded, becoming one of the spirits she loathes. In the haunted wilds of North America, the couple desperately searches for a way to liberate Antea from her new plight.

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, intimate and powerful story between two fated lovers. As Banishers, enter the lives of New Eden’s communities and solve haunting cases in a mystical, lore-rich world plagued with supernatural creatures and ancient secrets. Use your wits or combine Antea’s spiritual powers and Red’s arsenal to defeat and banish the souls tormenting the living.

Challenging decisions will lay on your path, dramatically impacting your story and the fate of New Eden’s inhabitants—be they living people or wandering souls. How much will you compromise your ghost-hunting vow for the sake of your lover who became one of such spirits?

Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden will be released end of 2023 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. Wishlist the game on Steam, sign up as a Focus member to get the latest exclusive info and upcoming special offers for Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden and the whole Focus catalog.
